_readme: THE STORE-VITALS THRESHOLDS — crash-rates (lead 7185eb, 2026-10-02; gate R11-05). Read by
tooling/ops/check-store-vitals.mjs, which grades every store-aggregated rate against the row for its
metric and EXITS 1 when the row it needs is missing (an ungraded rate is not a passing one).
One row per graded metric, `{value, asOf, verify, source}`: `value` is the LIMIT as a fraction of users
(0.005 is 0.5 %), `redWhen` says whether the limit itself is red (`atOrAbove`, 'below 0.47 %') or still
inside (`above`, 'at most 0.5 %'), and `amberFraction` is the share of the limit from which a rate is
amber ('amber inside 80 % of either limit'). Play's OWN published bad-behaviour threshold sits beside
each row in `play`, for comparison only: the grade is ours, and it is stricter.
The owner delegated these numbers ('i Approve, you always should do'); they settle gate R11-05, which
goes green on the first REAL reading, not on this file.

crash.label: user-perceived crash rate
crash.source: lead 7185eb thresholds, 2026-10-02: crash-free users at least 99.5 % (a user-perceived crash rate of at most 0.5 %)

anr.label: user-perceived ANR rate
anr.source: lead 7185eb thresholds, 2026-10-02: user-perceived ANR rate below 0.47 %
